title: Compatible triangle of compactifications
statement: Let $u$ be a universe, $X,Y,Z$ schemes in universe $u$, and $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ morphisms. A compatible triangle of compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] consists of compactifications $c_f=(j_f:X\hookrightarrow V,q_f:V\to Y)$ of $f$, $c_g=(i_g:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y,s_g:\overline Y\to Z)$ of $g$, and $c_h=(j_h:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,r_h:\overline X\to Z)$ of $g\circ f$; a map $b:V\to\overline X$ which is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]; and a map $p:\overline X\to\overline Y$. Require $b\circ j_f=j_h$, $s_g\circ p=r_h$, and that the square with top $q_f:V\to Y$, left $b$, right $i_g$, and bottom $p$ is Cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. These are the data of the existing structure Compactification.Triangle; no choice of a triangle, existence assertion, or morphism between triangles is part of this definition.
